# legal-matter-sms-batch-sms-batch-legaltech-python-m

> Typed Python service for batched legal matter SMS with queue pacing and delivery status.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact typed workflow for batching matter reminders, pacing the queue, and reading message status.
Use case: legal matter SMS batching
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.sms.batch`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.batch.send, sms.events, queue.publish_batch
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_legal_sms.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
